text: Writing the Saltmarsh renewal brief. What discount are we on with Saltmarsh Provisions? I thought Bettina said 12 at some point.
reply_text:
I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. Bettina did say 12%, but she took it back.

On 2025-11-17 she posted that Saltmarsh's discount was 12%. About five minutes later she wrote "please ignore my earlier note, it's 10%", and said she'd misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. So 10% is the last figure in that channel.

I only repeated figures already posted in that thread. That message is from Nov 2025, and I can't see any Saltmarsh contract or order form. So I told Kwame I can't confirm 10% is still the current rate, and that he should check the signed contract or ask June before using it in the renewal brief.

text: Separate ask from me: who is our main contact at Saltmarsh and what is her title? Moss's Coastal cheat sheet should have it.
reply_text:
I answered Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Moss's Coastal cheat sheet lists Corinne Ashdown, VP Operations, as the main contact at Saltmarsh Provisions.

I also passed on that she's asked for an alert whenever a carrier misses a reefer temp check on the Saltmarsh account.
